Add-ons are extra cars, downloaded from the launcher. In game, each player takes one with F10, like the VAZ: with their colour and number, or with their own livery.
Character > Add-ons: each available car has a Download button (NEW tag when it has just arrived).
Click Download with the game closed: the car installs into MWCoop\\addons.
New version: UPDATE tag and Update button. To remove it: click the car, then Uninstall (your livery is kept).

By hand works too: copy a car's folder (the one that contains addon.ini) into the add-ons folder. Everyone installs the add-ons they want to see: without the add-on, you see a VAZ of the same colour and number instead.
